answer: What survives to the dune is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. A pearl of per-task receipts records who did what, and the bridge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
